change: Balance float fine Wilson-Clover output sites in one-dimensional intervals, including single/batch, full/color and interior/boundary paths.

partition.tail: clip final interval to valid sites; no padded reads or writes

storage: Retain existing aggregate-major/EO layout and SIMD range kernels; logical flattening does not transpose the fields.
mpi: Main thread retains MPI progress; workers compute interior outputs and all threads compute boundary outputs after the existing barrier.
configuration: Experimental 37-thread solve profile added; frozen 052 profile unchanged.
diagnostics: The former LQCD_FINE_SCHEDULE block-level dynamic diagnostic is superseded by static site interval partitioning.

ctest.coverage: Core/kernel gates and CPU-only serial/MPI2 gates; fine_site_balance MPI1/2/4 with threads 3->37, single/batch, blocking/overlap.
fine_site_work, Wilson kernels, fine_site_balance MPI1/2/4, cpu_backend serial/MPI2 and distributed MPI2.

independent_check: Existing cpu_backend serial/MPI2 gates compare against a NumPy Wilson stencil. New 37-thread gates recompute full double residuals and compare single/batch solutions after collective thread changes.
